tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.title: Get AI Operator Leaderboard
tools.description: Read the current SignalAF board for 7d, 30d, 90d or all time. The default is the website Total / All view of claimed operators. Set view=platforms for the broader By platform / All view, including unclaimed public rows; a platform filter also uses that view. Results are ranked by published Yield and include the board link, scope, operating ratios, provenance and access cap. Ranking eligibility means inclusion on this displayed board; it does not mean the underlying measurement is verified. Unclaimed does not prove seeded origin.

ranking_eligible.description: On an operator row, eligible for the published board ranking in this scope; independent of measurement verification. False on the aggregate envelope because it is not an operator.

tools.name: compare_operators
tools.title: Compare operator structure
tools.description: Compare two public operators’ observable AI operating structure for a common window and cohort. Returns canonical metrics and differences only when evidence is compatible, otherwise incompatibility reasons. Does not infer intelligence, productivity, work quality or personality and does not change data.

tools.name: get_field_stats
tools.title: Get field statistics
tools.description: Get distributions and field size for the public SignalAF board. Defaults to the broader By platform / All population, including unclaimed rows; set view=total for the claimed-operator Total / All field. Returns available metric distributions and provenance. No unsupported evidence-class cohort or seed label is inferred.

tools.name: report_beta_bug
tools.title: Send beta bug report
tools.description: Send a concise SigRank | SignalAF beta bug report to hello@signalaf.com only after the user explicitly asks to submit it. Collect steps, expected and actual behavior; omit prompt content, credentials, raw logs and private telemetry. Returns a delivery reference or an error; does not alter operator data.
